rubric.explanation: Economic: output/jobs/funded obligations 40/30/30. Social: occupied housing/essential services/resilience 40/40/20; five equal service subweights. Environment: cover/reference-storm reduction/low-emissions supply/water pressure 40/25/20/15. All components cap at demand; no placement points. Targets and scenario quantities are pinned in this definition.

economy.assumptions: Scenario units, not measured population or utilities. Existing community outside project footprints: 4 homes, 4 jobs, 4 recreation, 4 local-service units. All eligible sites have fictional willing operators, access and utility connections. Drinking-water supply remains fixed; wastewater plants do not produce drinking water.

outcomes.economicExplanation: 40% output need + 30% sustained jobs + 30% due obligations funded. Jobs and outputs are illustrative; private activity is not treasury income.
outcomes.socialExplanation: 40% occupied housing + 40% energy, drinking water, wastewater, recreation and local-service needs (equal subweights) + 20% undisrupted sites. Resources limit occupied homes.
outcomes.environmentalExplanation: 40% cover/condition + 25% same-storm discharge reduction + 20% low-emissions supply + 15% water/treatment needs. All except reference runoff are authored indices, not ecological or health forecasts.
